newsitem.title: USA: Payless Cashways May same store sales fall.
newsitem.headline: Payless Cashways May same store sales fall.

text.p: Payless Cashways Inc, a building materials specialty retailer, said Thursday its comparable-store sales in May fell 2.5 percent from the same period a year ago.
Total sales declined four percent to $225.3 million from $234.7 million.
For the year-to-date, comparable-store sales were off 2.7 percent from a year ago. Total sales fell five percent to $1.15 billion from $1.21 billion.
Payless Cashways operates 193 building materials stores in 22 states.
